name: Wega's Super Custom Challenge
desc:
⚠️ NOW ALL AGE'S (bugs may be presented pleace give feedback)
Game Contains Flashing Lights And Loud Sounds   Be Carful !!

❓ Wega's Super Custom Challenge is a customizable Challenge Experience that mixes together the mechanics of Wega's Challenge: The Idol and Fangames with an Ultimate Custom Night-Styled enemy selection
Mix & match enemies from a large list where each one has unique mechanics that add their own level of difficulty and Chaos to your Game Play !
 
♾️ Select from various themed Challenges from the Challenge Menu or create your own, leading to a near infinite amount of combinations

This game is best experienced on PC ,Some things may not work as intended on other platforms
